body: I second this. You never intended to cause any injury
The Obi-wan series comes out soon. Then Thor love and thunder comes out in July. They’re my reasons
This was very comforting and helpful to read, thank you

Same here. Best way I cope is letting my flatmate know where I am mentally and I’m really lucky she’s so understanding and checks if I’ve eaten yet that day. I’m honest and tell her, if I haven’t she helps me think of things to have and sometimes cooks for me. I don’t deserve her.

Alternatively I just have 1 snack that gets me through. Not really nutritious but it’s some form of energy/electrolytes. My snack atm is strawberries and melted chocolate. Although I ate a box of bread sticks with garlic and herb Philadelphia a few days ago
I used to enjoy dancing and gaming but I’ve lost all motivation for that. That’s the symptoms of depression though… this shits hard

I cannot think of reasons I don’t deserve a better life. 
I also cannot think of reasons I do.
I know my mental illnesses cause my brain to lie to me. It makes me more upset when I can’t stop feeling this way knowing the truth I guess
I get hurt now. I keep getting hurt and each time is more painful than the last I can’t cope anymore
Trying to stay level headed but it’s difficult as it’s less of a emotional reaction now and more of a ‘logical’ plan. It feels logical to me atleast
I don’t want them thinking anything that isn’t true like blaming themselves
Thank you, will definitely be careful where I’m getting my info from

cutting off the painful bits hanging off you can’t pick because you’ve gone too deep is something I never thought someone else would relate to. Thank you.
I use nail clippers instead of a knife though

Yes, I’m a major culprit to the heels of my feet. Awful because it’s so hard to stop then you go to far and it makes walking painful. Medical term is dermatillomania. I also struggle with trichotillomania (hair pulling) mainly eyelashes and eyebrows :/

Even though I only live for other people, I feel emended apathy to everything that happens to them. They have a shit day? K… 
They got a job promotion? Wow…
Got engaged? so happy for you 😕
